mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) consistently predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns by reducing discount rates for equity valuations, with this relationship holding across all monetary regimes without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when FEDFUNDS is below its 5-year median is not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE increases by >0.3pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces corporate profitability, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises is not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 5-year rolling window, or the interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising), high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%) signals aggressive central bank action that typically triggers recessionary expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL > 5.0%, or the Rank IC for the condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1,200,000 units signals weakening consumer confidence and reduced construction activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1200.0, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales (RSAFS) above its 5-year average signals robust consumer spending that drives corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 60-day forward return when RSAFS is above its 5-year average is not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 5-year rolling window, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index, 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces economic output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates severe labor market deterioration that reduces household income and consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises is not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 5-year rolling window, or the interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.
